query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
FROM account_form_decisions
WHERE created_at > $1
  AND (
    $2::account_form_action IS NULL
    OR action = $2
  )
  AND (
    $3::bytea IS NULL
    OR address_digest = $3
  )
  AND (
    $4::text IS NULL
    OR recipient_domain = $4
  )
  AND (
    $5::bytea IS NULL
    OR profile_digest = $5
  )
  AND (
    $6::text IS NULL
    OR network_prefix = $6::text::cidr
  )
